recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical, high-contrast composition featuring a complex, fractal-like snowflake centered on a heavily textured frost background, overlaid with chiseled, ice-textured display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central snowflake acts as a structural frame for the main title
High-frequency frost textures contrast with smooth, glowing light glints
Monochromatic blue palette creates depth through value shifts rather than hue
Typographic texture mimics the physical properties of the background ice
coreInvariants: Radial symmetry of the central snowflake
Macro-crystalline frost pattern throughout the background
Internal glow emanating from the center of the snowflake

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central snowflake occupies 80% of the frame height; title text sits horizontally across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, glowing core of the snowflake behind the central letters.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Radial outward from the center to the snowflake tips, then downward to the secondary metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense and textured; no 'empty' space, but lower-contrast areas at the edges provide breathing room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean and Cobalt blue background and mid-tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White and pale cyan for highlights and crystalline edges.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep navy for shadows and depth within the ice cracks.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between dark crevices and bright, glowing highlights; saturation is consistent across the blue spectrum.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, flared serif with irregular, chiseled edges.
letterConstructionRules: Glyphs appear carved from blocks of ice
Top edges are jagged and uneven
Internal textures include cracks and frost patterns
Strong horizontal crossbars with slight tapering
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' features a swirling, circular internal frost pattern
Serifs are sharp and needle-like, resembling icicles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Highly illustrative, textured display type paired with a clean, legible classic serif for credits.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic, authoritative serif skeleton needed for the display text.
Clean, legible serif for the bottom metadata text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-resolution macro texture of frost and ice crystals in shades of cerulean and cobalt blue. Center a large, intricate, symmetrical fractal snowflake with sharp, needle-like points. Add a bright white glow emanating from the center of the snowflake and place small, sparkling light glints on the tips of the crystals.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the main title in a custom, heavy, chiseled serif font with jagged top edges. The letters should have a 3D beveled appearance and be filled with a fractured ice texture. Add the secondary credit text at the bottom in a clean white serif font with a subtle blue outer glow for legibility.

verificationChecks: Does the title text look carved from ice?
Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue?
Are there visible light glints on the crystal edges?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central light glow
Amount of jaggedness on the display font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the complex background
Check that the snowflake does not obscure the primary title
Verify the 3D beveling on the text feels consistent with the lighting
Confirm the frost texture has high-frequency detail
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Crystalline Centerpiece + Chiseled Ice Typography + Monochromatic Blue Frost Texture
